dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular closed-loop 'O' structures exhibit high-contrast dark perimeters with jagged, non-uniform edges surrounding lighter grey interiors. The gradient transition from the dark exterior border to the light core is sharpest in the central-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of diffuse high-intensity pixel clusters in the anterior (left-most) region. Solid, low-intensity pixel blobs are distributed with moderate density between the macro-annuli in the central body section.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the four most prominent 'O' structures in the central region form an irregular quadrilateral. A secondary geometric relationship is formed by a triangular alignment of three smaller 'C' shaped structures in the posterior-lateral quadrant.

other_distinctive_markers: A continuous reticulated network of interlocking high-contrast borders creates a lace-like texture across the entire lateral surface visible in the frame.
